name: Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1
tagline: First private orbital launch site: Rocket Lab's Electron from Mahia, New Zealand
description: On the Māhia Peninsula, on the east coast of New Zealand's North Island, Rocket Lab built the first private spaceport to host a successful orbital launch. It opened on 26 September 2016. The pads stand on a raised plateau about 104 m above the sea, with cliffs on three sides and a single access road. Electron's first flight, "It's a Test", left Pad A on 25 May 2017 and reached space but not orbit; the second, on 21 January 2018, put its satellites into orbit. Pad B flew its first mission on 28 February 2022. Rocket Lab's user guide gives a capacity of up to 120 launches a year. The company picked Māhia for its open sea to the east and sparse air traffic.
best_known_for: First private orbital launch site: Rocket Lab's Electron from Mahia, New Zealand
